paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: search the source code of hundreds of millions of websites with PublicWWW
# PublicWWW for DeepSeek Harness

Search the source code (HTML, JavaScript, CSS) of web pages
from DeepSeek Harness: which sites
load
a script, use a library, carry a tracking id or a widget.

This plugin connects the PublicWWW MCP server, `https://api.publicwww.com/mcp`,
through DeepSeek Har

ness's own MCP client. The agent gets PublicWWW's tools:
`search`, `account`, `read_docs` (the docum

entation and prices) and eight for
clusters, as `mcp__publicwww__<tool>`.
## Setup

Issue a token on your profile page - the
tools need a paid plan, a free account gets the documentati

on only - and keep it
in the environment:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then add the plugin to a profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or use the patch for a single run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview; if a newer version changes the plugin
format, the server it

self stays the same - any MCP client that can send an
`Authorization: Bearer` header works.
## Asking

"Which sites load angular.min.js?", "Find shops on .de that use the Klarna widget
and show the code

around the match", "How many PublicWWW searches do I have left
today?" The query syntax: publicwww.c
om/docs/query-syntax.
## See also

- PublicWWW MCP server - Claude,
ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI and others
- Documentation
